title: cancel_imminent_trigger
description:
Cancels what the interrupt window open is about to make happen, or replaces it ("would… instead": Reprieve, Iron Mine, Stand Your Ground…), or cancels the effects of an event or an ability (Censure, Voice of Honor, Mushin no Shin…): the condition of a card no longer occurs (a character no longer leaves play, nor its attachments with it), or that of a ring (a claimed ring no longer returns to the unclaimed pool: Wholeness of the World), or none of the window when neither is given. A window left without condition closes at once: what waited in it is not done, but an event or an ability, which is still played (its costs paid), its resolution marked cancelled; the replacement itself is applied with the effect messages.

Any player of the game can send it: the engine does not apply card effects.

card_id.description: Card whose imminent condition is cancelled (the character that would leave play, the event played or the card whose ability is triggered); every condition of the window when omitted.

ring.description: Ring whose imminent condition is cancelled (a claimed ring that would be returned), instead of a card.
